commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' 0 - 3 What a magnificent finish! Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) wonderfully times his run onto a cross and thunders the ball from deep inside the box into the left side of the net!
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
88' The referee allows time for a substitution. Giovanni Di Lorenzo will be replaced by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).
80' Antonio Conte has decided to make a change. Antonio Vergara (Napoli) replaces Alisson Santos.
79' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Leonardo Spinazzola walks off the pitch to be replaced by Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli).
79' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Antonio Caracciolo (Pisa) was quite harsh and Francesco Fourneau didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
78' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Alisson Santos (Napoli).
71' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) is substituted due to injury. Oscar Hiljemark gives a chance to Isak Vural.
70' Oscar Hiljemark has decided to substitute Mehdi Pascal Marcel Leris and he is replaced by Juan Cuadrado (Pisa).
70' Substitution. Arturo Calabresi did his best and is replaced by Idrissa Toure (Pisa).
70' Stefano Moreo (Pisa) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
68' Scott McTominay (Napoli) leaps like a salmon to meet a lofted ball into the box, but his header from near the penalty spot fizzes narrowly wide of the right post.
62' Alisson Santos (Napoli) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
62' Alisson Santos (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out for a corner. Napoli can continue in their attacking effort.
60' Ebenezer Akinsanmiro will be replaced by Gabriele Piccinini (Pisa).
60' Substitution. Filip Stojilkovic makes his way off the pitch and Henrik Meister (Pisa) comes on as his replacement.
59' Antonio Conte has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mathias Olivera (Napoli) replacing Alessandro Buongiorno.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) replaces Eljif Elmas.
53' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
53' Arturo Calabresi (Pisa) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
50' The corner is swung in but Pisa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

49' Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the roof of the net. Alex Meret pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. Pisa have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Francesco Fourneau has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' A nice lofted cross finds Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa) unmarked. He takes an excellent touch and gets in a shot that goes towards the bottom right post, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save!
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
39' A corner kick by Napoli is thwarted by the well prepared Adrian Semper (Pisa).

38' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the top right corner, but the effort is smothered by the keeper. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
37' Filip Stojilkovic (Pisa) takes a neat pass, dummies a defender and slams the ball well wide of the left post from the edge of the box.
31' The ball possession at the moment is 24:76.
27' 0 - 2 Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) reacts well to a deflected cross from Eljif Elmas and places a close-range header beyond the keeper into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
27' The referee awards a corner and Eljif Elmas (Napoli) goes over to take it.

26' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Alisson Santos (Napoli). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Good work from Napoli as they win a corner.

21' 0 - 1 Scott McTominay (Napoli) controls the ball on the edge of the box after a superb low pass by Rasmus Hojlund. He makes a yard for himself and fires a wonderful strike into the bottom right corner via the woodwork. 0:1!
18' Adrian Semper leaps like a salmon to deny Alisson Santos (Napoli), whose effort is headed to the underside of the crossbar, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net.
18' Alisson Santos (Napoli) takes a short corner kick.
16' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post!
15' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
15' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The linesman points to the corner flag, Napoli are going to take it.
14' Sam Beukema (Napoli) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but Adrian Semper is equal to it and makes an easy save.
11' The foul by Michel Aebischer (Pisa) was seen by Francesco Fourneau who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
9' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
9' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) prepares to take a corner kick.
8' Eljif Elmas (Napoli) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him. It will be a corner kick for Napoli.
4' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
